coverage_explanation: Checks increased displayed time after three completed D2 press/release cycles, including a sustained press, persistence while waiting for D3, and decreasing remaining seconds after a completed D3 cycle. All button-effect samples occur after release and settling, permitting either press-triggered or release-triggered implementations. The initial duration is unspecified, so completion, final zero, and the two-second alarm cannot be scheduled independently. The supported check schema cannot compare differences between captured values, so exact +10 increments, exactly one addition during the sustained press, and exact countdown arithmetic remain unverified.
assumptions: Relies on bench defaults: buttons D2 and D3 connect to GND with INPUT_PULLUP and are active LOW.
The initial countdown duration and startup display content are unspecified and are not asserted. The reference chooses zero.
Button actions may take effect on press or release; checks wait until after each complete cycle.
Three completed D2 cycles add at least 30 seconds before countdown starts.
The buzzer frequency is unspecified; the reference chooses a 1000 Hz carrier on D6.
Behavior of D2 during countdown and D3 during an active countdown is unspecified and is not exercised.
